# +1 / −1 / undo on the scoreboard page (spec 02 §7.3).
undo
expect error no game
plus home
expect error no game

start long
undo
expect error no goal
minus home
expect error no goal

sensor home_goal              # away 1
sensor away_goal              # home 1
plus home                     # home 2
expect score 2:1
undo                          # takes back the +1 (the last goal of any side)
expect score 1:1
expect last goal_voided side=home
minus away                    # takes back away's sensor goal
expect score 1:0
minus away
expect error no goal
undo
expect score 0:0
undo
expect error no goal

# Taking a goal back can decide the game: 10:9 → 10:8 with win by 2.
plus home
plus away
plus home
plus away
plus home
plus away
plus home
plus away
plus home
plus away
plus home
plus away
plus home
plus away
plus home
plus away
plus home
plus away
plus home
expect score 10:9
expect phase playing
minus away
expect score 10:8
expect winner home reason=score

# Corrections after the end are edits (M3), not live corrections.
undo
expect error no game
expect score 10:8
